The Resort
Take in the Northern Lights from the comfort of your bedroom and connect with the land, its people and history. Cross the Arctic Circle and discover something new under the Midnight Sun, only one hour from the Arctic Ocean.
Arrive either through Ivalo (IVL) or Kirkenes (KKN) airport or combine your stay with a trip to Kakslauttanen Arctic Resort, we’ll provide the transportation.

Accommodation
Spend your nights admiring the sensational views from our Kelo-Glass Igloos or sleep soundly in the comfort of our modern hotel rooms – the choice is yours.
Kelo-Glass Igloo
Book now
Kelo-Glass Igloo
Our Kelo-Glass Igloos combine the comforts of a cosy log chalet with the sensational experience of sleeping under the stars. Admire the enchanting beauty of the Northern Lights and the Arctic wilderness from the comfort of your own private hideaway!
Including: Made from Lapland’s unique Kelo pinewood, each Kelo-Glass Igloo sleeps up to six and features a private sauna, fireplace, kitchenette, and most importantly, a bedroom with a domed glass roof.
Book now
Luxury Kelo-Glass Igloo
Book now
Luxury Kelo-Glass Igloo
Our Luxury Kelo-Glass Igloos offer more space, comfort and views of the night sky. Each has three Log Chalet Double Bedrooms with private bathrooms and showers and three Glass Igloo Bedrooms for two. There is a large living room and common area with hand-made custom furniture, a kitchenette, and a sauna section that completes your ultimate Arctic accommodation.
Including: The Luxury Kelo-Glass Igloos can accommodate up to 12 guests comfortably, making them a great option for family reunions or groups of friends. Your stay also includes private airport transfers, daily firewood service, housekeeping and luggage service.
Book now
Superior Teno Room
Book now
Superior Teno Room
A cosy, spacious room that welcomes you back from the great outdoors. Complete with a kitchenette and private sauna, giving you total autonomy on your holiday. Other facilities, such as Pisara Restaurant, our reception, and gift shop, are conveniently located in the same building.
Including: With one double bed and sofa bed, these rooms are designed for up to four people, but some of the larger rooms can accommodate up to six people with extra beds.
Book now
Deluxe Teno Suite
Book now
Deluxe Teno Suite
Our Deluxe Teno Suites have all the comforts of home – and more. They feature two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living room, kitchen, sauna, and outdoor terrace, allowing you to relax and unwind at your own leisure.
Including: With a bunk bead in the living room, our Deluxe Teno Suites can easily accommodate up to six people in comfort.
